name: WholeStack WF-015: Comparable Sales Collector + ARV Engine

parameters.jsCode: const input=$input.first().json.body||$input.first().json; const required=['dealId','address','state']; const missing=required.filter(k=>!input[k]); return [{json:{valid:missing.length===0,errors:missing,dealId:input.dealId,property:{address:input.address,city:input.city||'',state:String(input.state||'').toUpperCase(),zip:input.zip||'',county:input.county||'',property_type:input.property_type||null,square_footage:input.square_footage||null,bedrooms:input.bedrooms||null,bathrooms:input.bathrooms||null,year_built:input.year_built||null,acreage:input.acreage||null},maxComps:Math.min(12,Math.max(3,Number(input.maxComps||8))),notes:input.notes||''}}];

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({model:$env.PERPLEXITY_PROPERTY_MODEL || 'sonar',messages:[{role:'system',content:'You are a real-estate comparable-sales research agent. Find CLOSED, RECORDED or otherwise explicitly documented comparable property sales that can support an ARV analysis. Never invent a sale, price, date, address, square footage, beds, baths, year built, or distance. Do not use active listings as sold comps. Prefer official county property/tax/land-record sources and other directly attributable public records. Return ONLY valid JSON with this shape: {comps:[{address,sale_price,sale_date,property_type,city,state,zip_code,sqft,beds,baths,lot_size,year_built,distance_miles,condition,source_record_id,source_url,confidence,notes}],limitations:[],search_notes:""}. Include only fields explicitly supported by a source. Each comp must have sale_price, sale_date, address, and source_url or source_record_id.'},{role:'user',content:'Subject property: '+$json.property.address+', '+$json.property.city+', '+$json.property.state+' '+$json.property.zip+'
County: '+$json.property.county+'
Property type: '+($json.property.property_type||'unknown')+'
Sqft: '+($json.property.square_footage||'unknown')+'
Beds: '+($json.property.bedrooms||'unknown')+'
Baths: '+($json.property.bathrooms||'unknown')+'
Year built: '+($json.property.year_built||'unknown')+'
Acreage: '+($json.property.acreage||'unknown')+'
Find up to '+$json.maxComps+' relevant closed sales, prioritizing recency, proximity, property type, and physical similarity. Do not estimate missing facts.'}]}) }}

parameters.jsCode: const ctx=$("Prepare Comp Request").first().json; const raw=$input.first().json; let content=raw.choices?.[0]?.message?.content ?? raw.output_text ?? raw.content ?? ''; if(typeof content!=='string') content=JSON.stringify(content); const citations=Array.isArray(raw.citations)?raw.citations:[]; content=content.replace(/^```(?:json)?\s*/i,'').replace(/\s*```$/,'').trim(); let parsed; try{parsed=JSON.parse(content);}catch(e){return [{json:{valid:false,errors:['Perplexity returned non-JSON comp evidence'],dealId:ctx.dealId,property:ctx.property,raw:content}}];} const comps=Array.isArray(parsed.comps)?parsed.comps:[]; const normalized=comps.filter(c=>c&&c.address&&c.sale_price&&c.sale_date).map(c=>({...c,state:c.state?String(c.state).toUpperCase():ctx.property.state,external_source:c.external_source||'perplexity_public_record_research',source_url:c.source_url||citations[0]||null,confidence:c.confidence??null})); return [{json:{valid:true,errors:[],dealId:ctx.dealId,property:ctx.property,comps:normalized,limitations:parsed.limitations||[],search_notes:parsed.search_notes||'',citations}}];
